name: What are the signs of a gas leak near a shutoff valve?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a gas leak near a shutoff valve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recognizing the signs of a gas leak is critical for safety. The most common indicator is the distinct smell of rotten eggs, which is an odorant added to natural gas for detection. Other signs include a hissing or whistling sound near the gas line or appliance, a visible cloud of dust or a white cloud near the line, or bubbles in standing water. If you suspect a gas leak, immediately evacuate the area, do not operate electrical switches, and call your gas utility company and a professional plumber from a safe location.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a gas leak near a shutoff valve include the smell of rotten eggs, a hissing sound, or bubbles in water. Evacuate immediately and call professionals if detected.
